Original mod by Mitz https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2121917837 If the original author requests it, I will remove this update.
--
Now uses [SYR] Processor Framework
--
Original mod notes (1.2):
Reduce lag farming chickens, get eggs the easy way. no attention needed. Big thanks to ISOREX_ for assistance in textures. Did a really good job on the coop! You can probably find him lurking in the discord as well if you want to help him learn how to make textures!
--- Adds a chicken coop object. Requires 5 fertilized chicken eggs, some wood and steel, and it gets built! Feed the chickens with hay or kibble (filling to maximum, 100, will grant 5 eggs) and wait 2 days for chicken eggs. Your colonist will collect the eggs when they're brewing... huh.
